newsitem.title: USA: Innovo Group investors double stake.
newsitem.headline: Innovo Group investors double stake.

text.p: Innovo Group Inc said it has signed a definitive agreement for an outside investor group to buy 6.75 million shares for $1.35 million.
That purchase would double the investor group's stake in Innovo to 16 percent from 7.5 percent, the company said.

The members of the investor group, Innovo's new Chairman and Chief Executive L.E. Smith, Chief Operating Officer Dan Page, J. Eric Hendrickson and Herb Newton, have joined the company's management and board of directors.
Innovo manufactures and markets fashion and sports-licensed tote bags, backpacks, duffel bags, laundry bags, and lunch bags as well as other nylon and canvas products for the crafts industry.
